## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Maintenance / chore / refactoring

## Checklist

- [ ] Code follows the style guidelines of this project (`ruff check .` and `ruff format --check .`)
- [ ] Tests have been added or updated to cover changes
- [ ] All automated tests pass (`pytest -q`)
- [ ] Documentation has been updated accordingly
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or private data are committed
